sens.name: Le cabinet des sens · The cabinet of the senses
sens.alt: The cabinet of the senses, a playful hands-on gallery of the museum with soft pale-green walls, a white column and a pale wood floor, seen from the near left. High on the back wall hang five big painted symbols of the senses: an eye, an ear, a nose, a hand and a mouth. At the left a weaver works at a big wooden loom glowing in a beam of light, a boy looks through a brass telescope, and a boy pinches his nose at a smelly cheese under a glass dome. In the middle a girl stands under a huge red umbrella beside its round shadow, a girl on a pile of presents raises her hand, a girl in headphones speaks into a microphone at a little radio desk, and a girl listens through a brass ear trumpet to a black coot bird. At the right a jester points with a big gesture, a girl covers her ears beside a steaming copper pot, a museum guard puts a finger to his lips behind a low glass case holding an old knight's lance, and a ceremonial guard in a red tunic and tall bearskin hat stares straight ahead. A white door on the left wall leads back to the exhibition hall; on the back wall a black door with a light-bulb sign leads to the cabinet of lights and a blue door with an ear sign to the cabinet of sounds, and a lilac door with a flower on the right wall leads to the cabinet of scents. Also on the back wall, a sunflower-yellow door with a painted flower leads to the cabinet of feelings, and a teal door with a painted flower leads to the museum classroom.

lumieres.name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
lumieres.alt: The cabinet of lights behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: deep midnight-blue walls with painted golden stars, a big golden crescent moon lamp, a lightbulb-shaped paper lantern and a mirror disco ball hanging from the ceiling. On the left a black door, a fisherman dangling a glowing lure over a round aquarium where a goldfish swims, a girl in green pulling aside the curtain of a pitch-dark booth where only two raccoon eyes glow, a girl holding up a glass teapot of clear tea in a beam of light, and a boy turning the brass dial of a tall glowing lamp while an owl on it squints. In the middle a silver-gray door with a painted eye in the back wall, a glowing blue jellyfish in a big glass jar, a girl shielding her eyes from a dazzling diamond on a velvet cushion, and a gray-haired tin seller polishing a sparkling pot on her cart. On the right a stagehand aims a big spotlight, a boy peers into a wooden chest whose black empty inside holds one pink neon tube, a girl points a laser pointer at the wall while a gray cat leaps for the red dot, a little wizard pulls a lever that lights a string of bulbs, and a child in a bedsheet ghost costume holds up a prism beside a fan of rainbow light. On the back wall at the right, a midnight-blue door with a painted flower leads to the cabinet of mysteries.

sons.name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
sons.alt: The cabinet of sounds behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: sunny yellow walls with painted sound-wave stripes and gray foam sound panels, a giant brass gramophone horn on the back wall. On the left a blue door and a girl in a yellow sweater pressing one key of a small white toy piano. In the middle a man lounging open-mouthed on a bench under the gramophone horn, a gray-haired grandpa watching his grandson sign to him, a rooster crowing on a wooden post, and a little silver robot tapping a xylophone. An orange door with a painted flower in the back wall behind a boy pushing a roaring vacuum cleaner beside a red toy car with flashing alarm lights, a boy jumping with a tissue and a whistling toy steam engine, a flamenco dancer clacking castanets, a grandma wincing in a creaky rocking chair below a red door with a brass music note in the right wall, two children whispering inside a giant old boot, and a boy tap dancing on a wooden board.

parfums.name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
parfums.alt: The cabinet of scents behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: sage-green walls hung with bunches of dried lavender and herbs, tall shelves of colorful perfume bottles and a big copper perfume still. On the left a lilac door with a painted flower, a lady spraying mist from a glass perfume bottle, and a perfume maker in a lab coat letting one drop fall from a dropper into a tiny vial. In the middle a girl tasting a spoonful of stew with her eyes closed, a mayor in a tricolor sash biting a lemon, a green parrot on a basket of pineapple, mango and dragon fruit, a boy shrugging and a girl pinching her nose at a pot of boiled cabbage, and a gentleman in a velvet jacket sniffing a white gardenia. On the right a pink pig sniffing a basket where a little rat peeks out, a smiling baker holding up a steaming pie, and a boy pinching his nose at a sneaker dripping green goo; behind him a honey-wood door with a painted hand. On the back wall, a cherry-red door with a painted flower beside the copper still leads to the cabinet of tastes, and a mint-green door with a painted flower behind the baker leads to the winter garden.

toucher.name: Le cabinet du toucher · The cabinet of touch
toucher.alt: The cabinet of touch beside the cabinet of scents, seen from the near left: terracotta walls hung with dried herbs, a giant bronze open hand, a big knitted glove, a sky-blue door with a painted flower in the back wall and a green door with a painted flower in the right wall. On the left a honey-wood door with a painted flower, a girl touching a glowing purple plasma ball, a girl holding up a huge cotton cloud on a stick, and a boy touching a mimosa plant whose leaves fold up. In the middle a boy rubbing sandpaper on a wooden block, a boy sinking into a cow-print beanbag, a girl touching a spiky cactus, a boy with sticky tape stuck from his collar to his fingers, a girl sitting on a wet floor after sliding in her socks beside a yellow cone, and a boy in a knit hat touching an ice swan. On the right a father holding a baby who grips his sweater, and a blindfolded boy holding up a pinecone from a wooden feely box.

optique.name: Le cabinet de la vue · The cabinet of sight
optique.alt: The cabinet of sight: pale sky-blue walls hung with optical illusions, a giant painted eye and a huge magnifying glass; an artist snips a black paper silhouette, a boy studies a vase-or-two-faces picture, a crossing guard in a hi-vis vest, a meditating girl with a golden glow, a boy squinting at an eye chart with his glasses in his hand, a tango dancer in a silvery dress, a man with a backpack heading off toward a big picture of a long road, a lilac door with a painted flower in the back wall and a dark wooden door with a painted flower in the right wall.

voix.name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
voix.alt: The cabinet of voices off the sound room: a dark blue recording hall with sound panels, a big gramophone, choir robes on hooks and stacked drums. By the red door with a brass music-note ornament on the left, a boy pushes a cart with a loudspeaker and a film projector, a choir in blue robes all raise their hands, three singers share a song beside a grandpa with a harmonica, a town crier in a clashing striped coat rings his bell, a grinning carpenter saws a squeaky plank, and a boy shouts at crayon scribbles on a white board. In front a baby squeals in a stroller as her mother covers her ears, a chatty girl holds a volleyball, and a nervous boy trembles at a microphone.

doors.hint: the red door with the brass music-note ornament on the left wall, back to the sound room

fete.name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
fete.alt: The party room off the sound room: a white hall with a checkered floor, paper lanterns, garlands, streamers, a little curtained stage and piles of presents. By the orange door with a painted flower on the left, a boy in sunglasses rides a skateboard, a wild boy bounces on a pogo stick, a grandma jumps rope, and a magician pulls a white rabbit from his top hat. In the middle a tower of folding chairs has toppled into a heap with a puppy on top while a boy sweeps confetti everywhere with a broom; a girl in a party hat blows a party horn by the birthday cake, and a relaxed man lounges in a striped deck chair, tie undone.

doors.label: Les sons
doors.hint: the orange door with the painted flower on the left wall, back to the sound room

matieres.name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
matieres.alt: The cabinet of textures off the touch room: a cozy wooden workshop with shelves of yarn balls, thread spools and rough rocks, a weaving loom and a patterned rug. By the honey-wood door with a painted flower on the left wall, a girl with poker-straight red hair smooths it down beside a laughing man with a huge bushy beard; a girl holds up a tangerine, a caveman-costumed boy rolls a stone wheel, a young grocer opens a burlap sack of potatoes, a girl strokes a sleek gray greyhound on a red leash, a boy points at an x-ray of a bony hand on a lightbox, and a boy holds out a smooth pebble.

labo.name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
labo.alt: The senses lab off the touch room: a bright white laboratory with blue cabinets, glass flasks, hanging lamps and big windows. By the wooden door with a framed flower picture on the left wall, a scientist holds a big white weather balloon, a man in goggles lifts the lid of a fogging dry-ice box, a man leans over a puffing aroma diffuser and a doctor shows a see-through anatomy model. A girl watches a tablet fizz in a glass of water, a boy holds a purple fleece jacket beside a woolly sheep, a girl stirs a paint pot into one smooth green, a robot arm hands a boy a cup, a girl aims a thermal camera, and a boy in a scarf shivers by an icy glacier model with a penguin.

couleurs.name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
couleurs.alt: The cabinet of colors off the optics room: a bright white gallery with color-chart paintings, a big color wheel and a potted plant. By the silver-gray door with a painted blue flower on the left wall, a painter paints a dark brown fawn, a girl watches a chameleon change color, a man squints at a misty painting, a boy in a red superhero cape checks a toy car for scratches, a golden egg rests in a velvet nest, a girl draws in her sketchbook, a little golden carriage with two white horses shines on a plinth, a boy beside a giant soap bubble, a girl twirls in a flowered dress before a gilded mirror, a girl holds an orange beside a blue ball, and a boy shades his eyes from a gleaming chocolate éclair.

caracteres.name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
caracteres.alt: The gallery of characters off the optics room: a deep green portrait gallery with gilt-framed paintings, a red velvet rope on brass posts and a glowing moon lamp. By the dark wooden door with a small painted flower on the left wall, a stern headmaster folds his arms, a boy in a red imp costume holds a cookie jar out of a little girl's reach, a puppy tugs a black cable against a laughing man, a lady puts her hand on her cheek as a smug boy cuts in front, a stingy man clutches his coin purse beside a donation box, an elegant lady in a silver gown dances under the moon lamp, a goofy stone head grins on a pedestal, and an appraiser studies an antique table with a loupe.

mysteres.name: Le cabinet des mystères · The cabinet of mysteries
mysteres.alt: The cabinet of mysteries off the lights room: a moonlit indigo room with bookshelves, candles and a tall arched window. By the midnight-blue door with a painted flower on the left wall, a bat hangs from a branch, a girl peers into a misty crystal ball, a boy holds a glowing orb, a moody pirate frowns at a treasure chest under a little rain cloud, a poison-dart frog sits in its terrarium, a fox tiptoes off with a sausage, a glum man stands under his umbrella, a sad collie rests its chin on a melon, a boy gapes at a swirling painting, a girl clings to the top of a tall ladder, and a man admires a model Gothic cathedral.

saveurs.name: Le cabinet des saveurs · The cabinet of tastes
saveurs.alt: The tasting kitchen off the scents room: a cozy kitchen with copper pans, a pastry case and a checkered floor. By the cherry-red door with a painted flower on the left wall, a baby taps a busy board, an old couple nod over warm cookies, a boy points at a strawberry cake, a boy holds up his strawberry ice-cream cone, a boy presses his nose to the cream-puff case, a girl sneezes near a bowl of peanuts, a toddler holds a triple-decker sandwich, a cook stirs a steaming pot, and a girl carries a birthday cake with one candle.

jardin.name: Le jardin d'hiver · The winter garden
jardin.alt: The winter garden off the scents room: a glass conservatory full of palms, flower beds, a pond and a stone fountain. By the mint-green door with a painted flower in the brick wall on the left, a girl watches a bird by its nest and a blue egg, a florist holds an armful of flowers, a girl cups clear water from the fountain, a boy spins a big globe, a calm old man sits by the pond where a turtle rests, a kitten mews up at a ripe red pear, a girl bites a fresh apple, and a lanky boy lifts a golden cup.

emotions.name: Le cabinet des émotions · The cabinet of feelings
emotions.alt: The cabinet of feelings off the senses room: a peach room with a climbing wall and a little stage with red curtains. By the sunflower-yellow door with a painted flower on the left wall, an emu nuzzles a girl who wipes a happy tear, a boy cries happy tears over a puppy drawing, a princess sits wide awake on a stack of mattresses, a toddler turns away from her toys with arms crossed, a boy climbs the rock wall, a girl holds a huge bunch of balloons, a goat nibbles an envelope, an opera singer flings out her arms on stage, and a lady in a sun hat lifts her nose in the air.

classe.name: L'atelier pédagogique · The museum classroom
classe.alt: The teaching workshop off the senses room: a bright classroom with a chalkboard, low tables and a toy train track, and a sunny-yellow door with a painted red apple on the right wall leading to the lunchroom. By the teal door with a painted flower on the left wall, a teacher acts out a volcano eruption, a boy fits the last jigsaw piece, a girl breaks the finish ribbon, a toy train pulls into its last station, a boy pushes a foam boulder up a ramp, a girl sits up wide awake by a ringing alarm clock, a toddler sits proudly on a chair, two kids in pedal cars wave each other on, and a girl sounds out vowels into an old telephone with a hand mirror.

cantine.name: La cantine des scolaires · The field-trip lunchroom
cantine.alt: The field-trip lunchroom through the yellow apple door of the museum classroom: white brick vaults, oak tables, a tray cart and an arched window. A blushing girl on a step stool hides a pudding cup behind her back, a girl gapes at a model of the U.S. Capitol, Sir Lancelot winces at his red throbbing thumb, a teacher points at FAST and QUICK on the blackboard, a chaperone named Lou fans out a deck of cards, milk spills over a limestone block, and a boy happily smudges charcoal up his arm.
